steps.description: Wait for the My Files page to load

screenshot.focus: My Files page header showing the Share files button

steps.verify: My Files page is visible with the Share files button

steps.description: Click the Share files button to open the Share Files drawer (article step 1)

screenshot.focus: the empty Share Files drawer on the right with the Add items and Recipients step active

steps.verify: The Share Files drawer is open with the empty upload area visible

steps.description: Upload tester/fixtures/test-document.pdf via the drawer's upload area (article step 2)

action.selector_hint: 'Click or drag a file to this area to upload'

screenshot.focus: the upload area showing test-document.pdf as uploaded

steps.verify: test-document.pdf appears as uploaded in the drawer

steps.description: Type the test recipient email into the Share with field and press Enter (article step 3)

screenshot.focus: the Share with block showing the recipient row added with the role dropdown set to Viewer

steps.verify: A recipient row appears in the Share with block with the test recipient email

steps.description: Click Next to move to the Select Policy step (article steps 4 and 5)

screenshot.focus: the Select Policy step with the policy dropdown visible

steps.verify: The Select Policy step heading is visible

steps.description: Open the Choose Policy dropdown to see available policies (article step 6)

screenshot.focus: the open Choose Policy dropdown with the available policies listed

steps.verify: The Choose Policy dropdown is open with at least one policy listed

steps.description: Select the default policy from the dropdown

screenshot.focus: the policy dropdown showing the Default policy selected

steps.verify: The Default policy is selected in the dropdown

steps.description: Click Share to complete the share (article step 8)

screenshot.focus: the Confirm step with the Sharing Successful heading and the file count

steps.verify: The Confirm step is visible with a Sharing Successful or shared-successfully message

steps.description: Click Copy Link to copy the protected link (article step 9)

screenshot.focus: the Confirm step showing the Copy Link button and any post-copy state

steps.verify: The Copy Link button shows a copied state or remains visible

steps.description: Close the Share Files drawer and return to My Files

screenshot.focus: My Files page showing the newly shared file row

steps.verify: My Files shows the test-document.pdf row with a share indicator

steps.description: Click the share icon on test-document.pdf to open the Share & Permissions Drawer (article 'After you share' section)

screenshot.focus: the Share & Permissions Drawer on the right with the Who has access heading

steps.verify: The Share & Permissions Drawer shows Who has access and lists the recipient

postconditions.description: After capturing screenshots, delete test-document.pdf from My Files to leave the tenant clean.
